column6: Explainer said "The rational numbers ℝ and ℚ"; changed to "The real numbers ℝ and the rational numbers ℚ"

Union-of-intervals correction said connectedness "depends on whether they meet or touch"; (0,1) and (1,2) touch at 1 but their union is disconnected. Now: connected exactly when the union is an interval, with (0,1) ∪ (1,2) as the counterexample. Pre-existing (not fixed): Explainer comes before Questions.
Spike defined as n on [0, 1/n], so fₙ(0) = n diverges and there is no pointwise limit 0 at x = 0; changed to (0, 1/n].
Bullet 1 says "the spike sequence converges pointwise to 0", false at x = 0 with the drafted [0, 1/n] spike; fixed through the How definition (now (0, 1/n]).
Same [0, 1/n] spike claimed to converge pointwise to 0; changed to (0, 1/n].
Same spike claimed to tend to 0 "pointwise everywhere"; changed to (0,1/n].
